title: Studio Shows
intro: Studio Shows are limited-cast productions for older performers to do some of the most focused, meaningful work of their time at PYT. With smaller casts and a close-knit creative process, Studio Shows are designed to build strong bonds between performers while giving the room to hone skills. Less about the spotlight, more about the craft and the community.
auditions_body: Our Studio Productions cast through open auditions, a welcoming first step onto the stage for newer performers. See the full list of audition dates and how to sign up.
